subject: Media Literacy
title: Radio: The First Mass Medium
description: A fast breakdown of Radio: The First Mass Medium for builders.

hook.text: In 1938, Orson Welles broadcast War of the Worlds on radio. People thought aliens had actually invaded.

buildup.text: Radio was the first medium that could reach millions of people simultaneously in their homes.

discovery.text: FDR's fireside chats used radio to build trust during the Great Depression — voice created intimacy.

twist.text: Hitler and Goebbels used the same medium to spread Nazi propaganda to an entire nation.

climax.text: Radio proved that broadcasting could unite people — or manipulate them on a massive scale.

punchline.text: Same radio. Different message. Different world.

quiz.question: What made radio revolutionary as a media technology?
options: It could reach millions simultaneously in their homes
